newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TAKE AN OVERNIGHT BAG FOR HOME GAMES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TAKE AN OVERNIGHT BAG FOR HOME GAMES.

text.p: Long suffering Brighton fans will not be amused.

The belleaguered English third division club, who must move from their Goldstone ground on the south coast in May, have been offered the chance to play their home games next season in the northern city of Carlisle -- 650 kms away.
"We'd do anything to help a fellow club survive," said Carlisle chairman Michael Knighton two days before the two clubs clash in the league. "We'd love to have them share our ground."
Brighton, who have been refused planning permission for a new stadium, have yet to respond to Knighton's bizarre offer.
